# Proposal

## Context
Our team has 2 peoples from 2 background: public health and biomedical science.  So we want each of us can apply the knownledge from this course into each member's field.

We plan to use the clinical and gene expression data

## Research question

Main research question
    - Does gene-expression information improve the prediction of overall survival beyond clinical characteristics in breast cancer patients?

Secondary research question
    - If gene-expression information improves prediction, how many gene-expression features are needed to retain comparable predictive performance?

Clinical

    - Logistic regression
    - L1/L2 regularization
    - Decision tree / Random Forest
    - SVM

Gene expression

    - Logistic + L1/L2
    - SVM
    - Tree ensemble
    - PCA → Logistic/SVM 

## Variables selection

The Nottingham Prognostic Index (NPI) was used as a composite prognostic variable instead of its individual components because several of the component variables had substantial missingness. This allowed us to retain prognostic information while reducing the impact of missing data and the number of predictors.

## Data prcocessing

Should do the normalization for age of diagnosis.

Cross-validation on x-train should be used to choose the hyperparameters.
